As we all (should) be aware, voat is currently supported out of pocket by Atko and Putitout, as well as by community donations. This model is obviously not sustainable for the site's ballooning hosting costs. Many, myself included have proposed placing ads on the site, as the most obvious source of revenue. While I find ads perfectly acceptable, provided they are not too intrusive, many have raised concerns about tracking and privacy issues with most ad networks, as well as the inherent malware risk of serving content hosted elsewhere. I therefore propose placing ads on the site IN AN OPT IN MANNER. By default, users will not see ads, this includes people not logged in. In account settings, people, if they choose, can ENABLE showing sidebar and banner ads to support the site. I think by making advertising opt IN rather than opt OUT or mandatory or mandatory with a subscription to disable, we can address all complaints about ads because those who don't want them (and frankly, probably have voat adblocked anyways) as the only people seeing them will be those who consciously decided to support the site by enabling them.

I don't think this is a good idea. Anyone who will opt-in is likely to click on the ads because they want to support voat, not because they want to see the ad. This will get you banned from any respectable ad serving company so fast it will make your head spin. I think that opt-out ads are the only way.

The best way to do it would be for voat to have its own ad system (sort of how reddit and twitter have promoted posts/tweets) rather than an ad network so that:

  • Ads are targeted to the community specifically (even subverses) and blend in better than standard banner ads
